_README: UAE EOCN Local Terrorist List — maintained in-repo because the Executive Office for Control & Non-Proliferation publishes it ONLY as PDF/Excel behind bot protection (no free machine-readable feed) and this repo is zero-dependency (cannot parse PDF/XLSX). Populate `entries` from the official download at https://www.uaeiec.gov.ae (Local Terrorist List). Each entry is either a plain string or { "name": "…", "aliases": ["…"] }. While `entries` is empty the screen reports UAE EOCN coverage as DEGRADED (incomplete) — it is never treated as a clean result. scripts/sanctions-watch.mjs can fingerprint the EOCN page so a change prompts an update here.
list: UAE Local Terrorist List (Cabinet / EOCN designations)
